title: Aces Up

hintReason.remove: Remove the top card of column [{{col}}] (the lower of a same-suit pair)
hintReason.move: Move column [{{col}}]'s card to an empty column
hintReason.draw: No moves available — deal one card from the stock to each column

tutorial.columns: Four tableau columns. You can act on the top card of each column.
tutorial.rules: Discard the lower of two same-suit top cards (Ace is highest).
tutorial.stock: Press Deal to deal one card onto each column.
tutorial.controls: Action buttons: remove, move, and deal.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.

landscapeBanner: Rotate to landscape for easier play
